subject: phy-u-fund
title: PHY.U.FUND.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 56 (SD(SY)-34). PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: C-AF-ALGN (composite affinity alignment) and C-INFO (composite information). From C-AF-ALGN: RE-ST (restructuralism). From C-INFO: OBS (observation). From RE-ST: TR-2 (transformation). From OBS: P-FC (particular focus).
